But I don’t think the Diggs signing is really bad for him. Sure, it probably caps his raw target ceiling some, but that hasn’t been Terry’s game anyways. He’s been a deeper aDOT guy who hasn’t been reliant on huge target volume, as his massive 2024 season was tied for his LOWEST target total of the last 4 seasons pre-2025 injuries.

A competent WR2 should theoretically help sustain more drives for this offense and gives them a better chance of being a really good unit like in 2024, meaning possibly more routes run and (more importantly) higher TD equity. I would imagine it will naturally take some more defensive attention off of Terry too.
